title: Chapter close — Models of QOUs
html:
Chapter close — Models of QOUs.

This closes the survey of categorical models of a quantum observable universe and the archimedean wall separating the substrate-level constructions from their archimedean realisations. The rigidity pairing at the wall—Mostow confinement on one side, finite-field / p-adic obstructions on the other—fixes which models survive the specialisation to numerical evaluation.

The next chapter (Descartes universe) makes the wall concrete. It chooses the archimedean model in which the substrate parameter q acquires a numerical value and the categorical objects are realised as sections of bundles over Bring's surface. The remaining chapters trace the consequences of that choice through the physical-prediction layer.
